name: system1-lander
description: A lunar lander flown in real time by a small System 1 decision model (Ollama /v1/systemone): the model judges prose, code maps choices to controls.
author: Andrew Rapo

scripts.check: for f in lander/*.mjs lander/*.js lander/providers/*.mjs lander/tools/*.mjs hello.mjs; do node --check $f || exit 1; done && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('lander/modes/prose.json'))"
